name: Admin status report
description: Displays configurable status/warning messages (including core status-report errors and warnings) via a pluggable message system shown through Drupal's messenger.
project_description: The Admin Status Report module surfaces status-related messages to site users through Drupal's messenger. It defines an 'AdminStatus' plugin type; each enabled plugin contributes one or more messages that are shown on page requests. Two plugins ship with the module: 'Core Status Report' (core_status_report), which renders selected error and/or warning items from the core status report (/admin/reports/status) as messages, and 'Default Message' (default_message), which shows an admin-defined status/warning/error message. An admin configures which plugins are enabled and their options at Administration > Configuration > System > Admin Status Report (route admin_status_report.admin_status_form, permission 'administer admin status report'); the choices are stored in the admin_status_report.settings config object under plugin_status. A kernel.request event subscriber reads that config on each request and pushes the enabled plugins' messages through the messenger. The project is marked obsolete/unsupported on drupal.org.
